svg.title: The Maester's Chain
svg.desc: Pixel art: a maester's chain of interlocking links in iron, bronze, gold, silver, black iron and copper, hanging on dark red velvet. One link for each discipline. LANGUAGES (iron): Python, Java. ML / DL (bronze): PyTorch, scikit-learn. LLMS & AGENTS (gold): LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, RAG, vector DBs. GEOSPATIAL (silver): Rasterio/GDAL, GeoPandas, Sentinel-1/2, STAC. WEB (black iron): React, Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript. TOOLS (copper): Git, Supabase, Vercel, Render, n8n.
